courses.title: SQL & Databases with PostgreSQL
courses.summary: Write, check and trust SQL on a broker's real-looking data, and build its reconciliation app along the way.
courses.lead: Learn to write, check and trust SQL on one broker whose insurer statements never quite match its own books, and build its reconciliation app along the way.
outcomes: write and debug SQL queries, from a single table to window functions;
design tables, constraints and migrations that keep financial data correct;
reconcile two sources honestly: matches, differences and ambiguous cases;
run a small internal app on Supabase with row level security, and change it yourself.
